dataset.name: UCI Student Performance (student-mat + student-por)
dataset.split: GroupShuffleSplit by student demographics (20% held out)
dataset.target: G3 final grade, scaled from 0-20 to 0-100

features.label: Internal marks
features.help: Current internal assessment score, normalised to 0-100.

features.label: Study hours / week
features.help: Self-reported study hours in a typical week.

features.label: Previous marks
features.help: Most recent previous result, normalised to 0-100.

transformations: study_hours = UCI studytime category midpoint (2, 4, 7 or 12 hours/week)
disclaimer: Prototype model trained on the public UCI secondary-school dataset. Predictions are estimates, not guarantees. Accuracy for university students has not yet been validated. Relationships are associations, not causes.
